**DIAGRAM CATEGORIES FOR Uq-TILTING MODULES**

*HENNING HAAHR ANDERSEN AND DANIEL TUBBENHAUER*

50 pp, 18 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a diagrammatic presentation of the category of Uq(sl2)-tilting modules T for q being a root of unity and introduce a grading on T. This grading is a “root of unity phenomenon” and might lead to new insights about link and 3-manifold invariants deduced from T. We also give a diagrammatic category for the (graded) projective endofunctors on T, indicate how our results could generalize and collect some “well-known” facts to give a reasonably self-contained exposition.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 1.1 The framework; 1.2 An outline of the paper; 2 The tilting category T; 2.1 Quantum groups at roots of unity; 2.2 Weyl modules, dual Weyl modules and simple; 2.3 Tilting modules and the tilting category T; 2.4 The linkage principle and blocks; 2.5 Translation functors; 3 The Khovanov-Seidel quiver algebra and gradi; 3.2 Combinatorics of the graded, right Qm- and; 3.3 Endofunctors on pMod-Qm and pMod-Qin; 3.5 The tilting category T and its graded coun; 4 Diagrams for the graded tilting category Tgr; 4.1 The basics: diagrammatic categories, addit; 4.5 Diagram categories for Endo(Tgrl); References
